description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Yuffie (Water)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Yuffie (Water)
description.text: Increases [Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Yuffie (Water) after using a Ninja ability (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Clearest Tranquil+
description.text: 4/5/6 single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each) if the user has Physical Blink 0/1/2, capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, grants [Physical Blink 1] and [Physical Blink Stacking 2] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Yuffie (Water)
description.text: 6/8/10 single ranged attacks (0.59 each) after 1/2/3 uses, grants [200% ATB 1] and [Ninja Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
